appointmentPage.title: Send your appointment request
appointmentPage.description: Guests can request an appointment here even if they are not yet official clinic patients. Once the clinic confirms your schedule, a confirmation email will be sent to you automatically.
appointmentPage.formDescription: Required fields should match the same patient registration details used by the clinic.
appointmentPage.procedureHelperText: For all other procedures, please book a consultation first so the dentist can assess the best treatment plan for you.
appointmentPage.notesHelperText: You may leave this blank if you only want to reserve a consultation slot.
steps: Choose the branch that is most convenient for you.
Prepare your name, contact number, email address, and preferred visit schedule.
Send your request and wait for clinic confirmation.
Visit the clinic for your consultation or scheduled appointment.
